name: Alpha Prime
description: Alpha Prime is a singleplayer first-person shooter game.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX
audio_settings.reason: Automatically enables EAX in Alpha Prime's configuration.

audio_settings.title: Enable stereo sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets Alpha Prime's speakers to stereo sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable headphones
audio_settings.reason: Sets Alpha Prime's speakers to headphones.

audio_settings.title: Enable Pro Logic surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets Alpha Prime's speakers to Pro Logic surround sound.
audio_settings.follow_up: Don't forget to set your AV receiver or Soundbar to Dolby Pro Logic.

audio_settings.title: Enable 4.0 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets Alpha Prime's speakers to 4.0 surround sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable 5.1 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets Alpha Prime's speakers to 5.1 surround sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable 7.1 surround sound
audio_settings.reason: Sets Alpha Prime's speakers to 7.1 surround sound.

notes: Alpha Prime sets its speaker option back to stereo every time it starts, so the speaker settings offered later don't last. That happened with Proton's default PipeWire audio driver, and with a 7.1 output on the PulseAudio driver.
